comparison.objective: Adjust and lock an articulated gripper stop versus depanel a scored circuit board and tray the freed board.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two concentric tools to regulate screw and jam-nut rotation; depaneling registers a score line, braces a frame, and applies controlled downward bending to fracture it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained opening across cycles; depaneling requires a valid edge-supported downward break, intact placement in a tray, and safe scrap placement.
comparison.reason: Although both use bimanual reaction control, one preserves a calibrated threaded setting and the other produces controlled fracture.
